cues.text: Cover, frame one (round 1): the departures board settled, TO GOOGLE ADS: LEADS MOVE, SPEND STAYS, CLICKS STAY, the host in frame pointing. At 0.9 s Google's help card types the reports line; STAYS BEHIND stamps and the band turns red on "reports".
The save file (levelselect): FOR WHOEVER RUNS YOUR GOOGLE ADS; step 1 lights on "screenshot", step 2 on "max"; then the card holds still while the voice names who to send it to. The send card.
The calendar (EXAMPLE): DOWNLOAD DAY, the gold week frame slides row to row and finds no date; SOON; tag Ads Help, read Nov 7, 2026.
Google's help line on the max typed on; NO MAX stamps on "no".
The tool belt (inventory), YOUR NUMBERS: SCREENSHOTS picked, then YOUR MAX. Then the end card with the send line.
